title: armeria maritima subsp. pinifolia
intro: Armeria maritima subsp. pinifolia, commonly known as Sea Pink, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the Plumbaginaceae family. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, and research has shown that it possesses several health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities, which can help protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Sea Pink include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety and stress, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Armeria maritima subsp. pinifolia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
